The 2002 San Marino Grand Prix (round 4, held at Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari on 14 April 2002) was won by Michael Schumacher for Ferrari, starting from pole. Rubens Barrichello was second for Ferrari, and Ralf Schumacher third for Williams.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher
